These are the same people telling us to “follow the science.” 
https://t.co/rIN0fPj7Nv

Our TX-24 Hometown Hero of the week is Donna Cranston, founder of Defenders of Freedom, where she partners with the medical community to treat veterans with brain treatment. Thank you, Donna, for supporting our veterans and impacting their lives for the better. https://t.co/YVF7V5rHW8

I am deeply saddened to hear of the loss of the four marines during a NATO exercise in Norway. 

We must always remember the sacrifices our service members make to preserve our liberty. My prayers are with their families and friends.

Biden continues to put Americans’ liberties last.

My lawsuit with the CDC puts it plainly: Congress never gave the CDC the power to order universal masking on airplanes, and executive agencies cannot exercise power that Congress did not give them. 
https://t.co/cpHoK2kmCp

@mo_oakville A key part of our plan to hold the government accountable in our Commitment to America is to end special treatment for members by repealing proxy voting. You can read more below: https://t.co/xp5g7hqOxa
🥇 Congratulations to Krish Agarwal of Coppell High School for winning first place with his app, Right Exercise! https://t.co/AGuTIYkqPf

https://t.co/uo0dZ04CbE

PSA: Lifesaving opioid reversal medication is now available over-the-counter. This is great news for North Texas, and for all Americans. Of course, we still MUST act to secure our border to stop the flow of deadly fentanyl.

Our #TX24 Hometown Hero of the week is Martha Day, who has gone above and beyond for expecting mothers in financial need. Martha’s non-profit organization, Vitamin Bridge, has helped nearly 50,000 mothers-to-be receive prenatal vitamins and nutrition education at no cost. https://t.co/MSrbMPkBn8
I appreciated hearing about new developments in cancer treatment when meeting with Novocure yesterday. https://t.co/PKeK9oVxaw

The Secret Service and the Biden transition team were tipped off about the planned Hunter Biden interview and interference by the Department of Justice allowed him to avoid tax evasion charges. Do you think YOU would’ve been given the same treatment? We’re working to dismantle this two-tiered system of justice and hold corrupt bureaucrats accountable! https://t.co/dkziGf0ZGz

Every American is entitled to their earned Social Security benefits, but the Windfall Elimination Provision prevents many from receiving these in full. I co-sponsored the Equal Treatment of Public Servants Act to update the outdated formula used by the @SocialSecurity Administration that treats teachers, police, and firefighters unfairly, even if they paid into Social Security while working a second job in the private sector.

According to a pediatrician tasked with monitoring the conditions and treatment of migrant children in CBP custody, children were separated from their parents by the Biden Administration. You can read more here: https://t.co/gr1hqpqrk0

Less than half of Veterans who need help receive the treatment they need, and I’m working to change that. People who suffer from depression and PTSD, some of the most common mental health disorders seen in Veterans, are at high risk for suicide.

The VA has great resources to help you better understand your emotions in order to get you started on your recovery journey. Don’t wait, reach out. #SPM23 https://t.co/vJQItZ9r0X

Opioid overdose is a leading cause of death in our country and can affect anyone. I want to remind our Veteran community that the VA offers flexible options for care, including telehealth options. https://t.co/mCXzerMvxs

As we continue to learn more about the Biden family’s influence peddling scheme and the preferential DOJ treatment of Hunter Biden, we’re grateful to the IRS whistleblowers who have risked their careers to report wrongdoing.

Today, I’m joining my @WaysandMeansGOP colleagues for a closed-door session (which is legally required to protect taxpayer information) where we will receive more information as we work to provide transparency to the American people.

For more information on @HouseGOP’s impeachment inquiry, you can visit: https://t.co/C17A46jYlD

I met with North Texans from the @SusanGKomen Foundation yesterday to discuss the Access to Breast Cancer Diagnosis Act and Safe Step Act, both of which I’m cosponsoring. Thank you for coming by! https://t.co/NN3vUNnjOW

Today, @WaysandMeansGOP is holding a hearing on the physical, emotional, and sexual abuse faced by foster youth in residential treatment facilities. Tune in as we discuss solutions that will better serve American families and children: https://t.co/73vD4JygYQ

I had a great conversation with @RESULTS_Tweets this week about child nutrition and how we can use the tax code to ensure children and families remain stably housed and don't go hungry. https://t.co/Fjbi4KfVn8

Two out of ten Veterans with PTSD also suffer from Substance Use Disorder. In addition to #SuicidePrevention Month, September is also National Recovery Month. There are treatment options to help, you don’t need to go through this alone. https://t.co/8Iac5KcuZa https://t.co/wCKIQDaaLJ

Inpatient rehabilitation facilities play an important role in helping patients recover from traumatic injuries, strokes, spinal cord injuries; however, Medicare Advantage enrollees are struggling to access this vital care. 

Yesterday, I led a bipartisan group of more than 50 of my colleagues in urging @CMSGov to include rehabilitation hospitals in MA plans.

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

1 in 8 women will face a diagnosis in their lifetime. This month, and always, we support the warriors and celebrate the survivors. 🎀 https://t.co/HWDNcJ1K2m

This week, I brought together more than 50 of my colleagues in urging CMS to improve access to inpatient rehabilitation care for Medicare Advantage enrollees. We’re working to ensure patients receive the care they need for a successful recovery. https://t.co/z0se6tSd4X

Lung cancer accounts for 1 in 5 of all cancer deaths. This Lung Cancer Awareness Month, we celebrate the survivors and honor those lost. Learn more about prevention, treatment, and early detection: https://t.co/Fz1Ejebr5s

It’s election day! Make sure you exercise your constitutional right. Polls close at 7pm! 🗳️ 🇺🇸
https://t.co/InKifF5hZV

Congratulations to Richardson resident, Stephen Knight, on his national recognition as Hero of the Year! Stephen has been sober for 13 years and runs a nonprofit that helps addicts going into treatment find foster homes for their dogs. https://t.co/HK4oOGboQU
